facades.name: Vijzelstraat front (hotel)
facades.note: Bottom to top: the gallery (shops behind the seven arcade piers: one shopfront per arch, partly behind street furniture, not countable as openings: null); the low mezzanine windows 8.0-9.2 m (12, one per bay at 4.05 m); the wide pointed-top windows 9.6-12.4 m (12); then three storeys of canted oriels. Each oriel has a front light and a narrow light in each cheek, but the panorama camera stands mid-front, so it sees only the cheek facing it (24 openings a row on the crop where the model, drawn true, has 36): the oriel rows are null rather than a count of the camera's view. The top silhouette is the mansard between the two corner towers, cut by the crop at both ends: no peak count. alongM keeps ring edge 7 only (the hotel front, 51.7 m), cutting off the bridge, the south tower and the annex, which face the same way (the silhouette starts at the annex's south end, 55.5 m before the front).
